notes: The %space(dev=,val=) macro (array-driven COMPRESS(...,'s') whitespace normalization on every character variable, then PROC COMPARE) is unmodified. The repo had no caller for this macro (dev=chk1, val=chk2 referenced datasets that do not exist anywhere in the repo), so a small caller was written: chk1/chk2 mock datasets whose 'name' values differ only by extra internal whitespace ('Balaji  M' vs 'Balaji M'), so the space-normalization technique has something real to demonstrate. Confirmed: PROC COMPARE reports 2 matched, 0 unequal after normalization.
